dialogs:
Turn "Medicube - PDRN Glow Booster Set (Pink Edition)" into a set?

Everything it has now stays: its price and sale price (they become the set's price), SKU, pictures, description, tabs, search appearance, reviews and its web address.

Next, add the products that are in the box, then press Save. Nothing changes on the shop until you save.

Stock: when this set is sold, one of each product in the box comes off that product's own stock. This product's own count (7 now) still applies as well -- untick "Count individual units" if the box alone should decide.

You can switch it back to Simple later, and the box is kept.
